_comment: Reed's 'what shots work' library. The feedback loop grows this: reed-generate.js logs an attempt, the (not-yet-fired) rating loop sets rating by OUTCOME, uses increments per generation. rating is null on every seed ON PURPOSE — the Lucy audit's whole point is that Reed has 1205 images and 0 outcome-ratings. These are proven shot TYPES (from reed-lab/shot-list.json subjects, catalogue.json generations, and the higgsfield-prompting-bible.md), not proven by Paul's reaction yet. rating scale once it fires: 1-5. tool reflects 2026-06-02 reality (Higgsfield depleted until ~06-12; image briefs route to OpenArt manual prompt or resume Nano Banana Pro after renewal; video = fal Seedance). See ~/cathedral-vault/06_Methods/reed-tool-memory.md.

shots.subject: bagwork
shots.description: Heavy bag, single boxer, full-power cross landing. Low warm key light, hard shadow, sweat as discrete specular droplets. Documentary grade, tack-sharp, anti-orange 5200-5600K.
shots.notes: Single-subject full-power shot is the bagwork archetype in shot-list.json (need 2). Low-warm-light bag work is the flagship Reed look.

shots.subject: details_bags
shots.description: Speed bag, close push-in dolly. 1 shot / 4s / 9:16. Camera starts wide on hands, pushes to tight on the bag's rhythm. Diegetic rat-a-tat audio. Motion blur on bag only, hands tack-sharp.
shots.notes: Push-in is a clean ORB/POV-adjacent move (see bible Format 2). Paid video — cap, don't batch. Prefer Kling 3.0 once Higgsfield renews.

shots.subject: details_gloves
shots.description: Close-up of hands wrapping wrists, lacing up. Shallow depth of field, gradual bokeh transition, Lonsdale/glove leather texture. Warm shadow, clean highlight. The quiet ritual before work.
shots.notes: details_gloves track needs 2. Hand-wrap closeup is a proven evergreen detail shot. Gradual bokeh prompt for DoF realism.

shots.subject: coaching
shots.description: Coach Paul portrait, mid-instruction, adjusting a student's stance. Soul V2 face lock then Nano Banana Pro gym grounding (two-pass). Documentary, eye-line off camera, natural gym light.
shots.notes: Customer-facing name is ALWAYS Coach Paul, never Reed. Two-pass face technique. coaching track needs 2.

shots.subject: sparring
shots.description: Two boxers mid-exchange, caught in action, noir grade. High contrast B&W, hard single light source, silhouette moment. The most-generated proven look in the catalogue.
shots.notes: Noir sparring is the single most-generated style in catalogue.json (8 noir gens). Already has 2 in shot-list, need 3. checkSceneSafety: img-only, no contact hallucination on solo pipeline.

shots.subject: padwork
shots.description: Pad work, coach feeding mitts, student throwing a 1-2. Side lighting, motion energy, sweat physics. pro_photo v2 grade. Mid-action freeze, tack-sharp.
shots.notes: padwork is top open assignment in shot-list.json (need 3, have 0). Highest current shot debt.

shots.subject: bodyshot
shots.description: Close-up of a body punch landing on the bag/pads. Compression on the leather, glove dug in, ribcage of the bag flexing. Tight crop, dramatic side light.
shots.notes: bodyshot track needs 2. Impact-moment crop. Body punch generation prompt is a filed BR standard.

shots.subject: gym_empty
shots.description: Empty gym at golden hour. Atmosphere, the space itself, light raking across the floor and bags. No people. Warm shadow, lifted blacks, the calm before class.
shots.notes: gym_empty track needs 2. Atmosphere/establishing shot — strong opener for a reel or carousel.

shots.subject: footwork
shots.description: Lateral movement / pivot caught mid-transition. Low angle on feet and floor, stance shifting weight. details_floor crossover. Crisp, zero motion blur on the planted foot.
shots.notes: footwork track needs 2. Low-angle floor work doubles as a syllabus/teaching asset.

shots.subject: warmup
shots.description: Skipping rope warm-up, near-silhouette against a window/wall light. 1 shot / 4s / 9:16. Rope arcs in motion, body tack-sharp, locked camera. Diegetic rope-whip + foot-tap audio.
shots.notes: warmup needs 2. Rope motion reads well in short video. Paid — cap. Prefer Seedance Fast once Higgsfield renews.

shots.subject: student_moment
shots.description: Student moment between rounds — toweling off, water break, focus face. Candid, documentary, natural light. The human beat that makes the gym feel real.
shots.notes: student_moment needs 3 — the highest-count human-interest track. Real > polished is the whole point here.

shots.subject: gym_class
shots.description: Full class in session, wide shot, group energy. Everyone working bags/shadow. Deep focus, documentary grade, the room alive. Anti-orange, lifted blacks.
shots.notes: gym_class needs 2. Wide group shot — social-proof asset for retention content.
